title: A House for the Hymn
author: A. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Elodie Brightwater, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
